title: Steady Beat · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Steady Beat · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose one player as the timekeeper. The timekeeper taps a steady gentle beat and the lead joins for eight taps. The lead stays with the beat for all eight taps, as judged by the group. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Steady Beat, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead stays with the beat for all eight taps, as judged by the group.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The lead stays with the beat for all eight taps, as judged by the group.
